turns.question: What share of the customers who signed up in September 2026 placed an order within 30 days of signing up?
turns.answer: About 33.3% (one third) of the customers who signed up in September 2026 placed their first order within 30 days of signing up, counting the signup day and the 29 days after it. Freshness: Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
